$comment: research/figma-dumps/kit-variables.json — the RAW Figma variables-API dump Task D1 ingests directly. Deliberately NOT the same shape as src/ingest/figma-export.schema.json's 'variables' sub-object (that describes the merged, forward-designed figma-export.json artifact Plan A assembles). Probed 2026-07-11 with `jq '.collections[0], .variables[0]'`: collections[].modes[] key is `modeId` (not `id` as figma-export.schema.json assumes), and each variable's type field is named `type` (not `resolvedType`). Validated with the hand-rolled checker in src/lib/validate.mjs (type/enum/required/properties/additionalProperties/items only).

libraryCollections.$comment: Empty in the current dump (no library-linked variable collections). Kept loose (unvalidated items) — out of scope for D1.

valuesByMode.$comment: Keyed by modeId. Value shape varies: COLOR -> {r,g,b,a}, FLOAT -> number, STRING -> string, or an alias -> {type:'VARIABLE_ALIAS', id}. Intentionally unconstrained here (mirrors figma-export.schema.json's own valuesByMode comment).
